round: V22: non-negative leaf clamp in search (fix for avoidable certain-death moves found by the V21 death audit)
change: At depth-1 leaves the search uses max(0, V(afterstate)). The true future score is never negative; negative estimates made a certain-death move outrank a survivable one.

models.NEW: training/v21-late-train/models/NEW.bin (sha256 e3f0b522...; base stages 0/1, V21 S2 stage 2, V21 S3 stage 3)

arms.CUR: CUR without clamp: existing V21 audit replays (same seeds, same search), not rerun

pools: Same as V21: EVAL3072 (1024, target first 6144, rollout base 21710001) and EVAL6144 (512, target 12288 or death, rollout base 21720001). These pools were used in V21; V22 tests different comparisons on them, paired by snapshot and rollout seed.
search: 5-ply, cutoff 0.01, complete depth each move, native C++ (training/v21-late-train/snap.cpp with CLAMP=1).

primary.P2: E2 mean score gained: CURc - CUR (paired t)
primary.P4: E2 mean score gained: NEWc - CURc (paired t)

multiplicity: Holm across P1-P4. No interim analysis; all runs to completion.
secondary: 12288 counts, 3072-beside-6144, avoidable certain-death final moves (death audit fields), ms per move.

adoption.clamp: Adopt if P1 or P2 is better after Holm and neither P1 nor P2 is worse at nominal p<0.05.
adoption.stage2: Adopt the V21 S2 stage-2 table (with clamp) if P3 is better after Holm.
adoption.stage3: Keep the adopted V21 stage-3 table unless P4 is worse at nominal p<0.05.
